title: Rakuten Travel rate collection
description: Run at most twice daily for one approved Rakuten Travel facility. Multiple stay dates are collected in the same actor run.

startUrls.title: Rakuten Travel facility URL
startUrls.description: A single HTTPS URL on travel.rakuten.co.jp for a facility approved for use in this service.

stayDates.title: Stay dates
stayDates.description: One-night check-in dates in YYYY-MM-DD format. All dates are collected in one controlled actor run.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult guests used for the displayed rate.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Only JPY is supported by the Revenue Assistant integration.
